followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept five scoped parent records and seven phases with all fifteen guarded challenge edits. followup_reviews.Research finding: The Nepal cabinet border-seal orders are supported. Two overlapping announced windows are retained and are not counted as complete observed closures. Initial human movement across the India and China land frontiers, with essential goods excepted. Later authorised Nepalese returns, emergency and pensioner windows, and foreign-permission rules qualify national wording. SA021-R1 is the one-week schedule from 23 March 2020 at 10:00; SA021-C1 is the 29 March amendment to 7 April. Neither scheduled endpoint establishes passage. The 28 January 2021 easing, 5 February Uttarakhand bridge movements and 6 February Kakadbhitta four-wheeler restriction are distinct and compatible. Health and biosecurity / Human disease control is directly attributed to the government’s coronavirus-control purpose; no additional rationale inferred. Both cabinet reports and the two local operation reports were freshly read. Nepal Press supplied an indexed extract after direct 403; the scholarly PMC article was inaccessible behind CAPTCHA and supports no new finding. Both phases remain unlocated in the announced-window layer. Later named bridges cannot supply a nationwide physical reopening or override opposite-side controls.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 75f71973a192fafd898d69eee3f642a94b186f28c8ab91f32c95fb2d2560df1a. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the full fixed sample audit of 16 parents and 27 phases, including 29 guarded input-cell corrections and the new Sadao onset question. Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R05-BQ05 — Actual all-post onset, enforcement continuity and final unrestricted reopening are not established and are not claimed. Prior permits and local operations must remain distinct.
